title: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4%; two officials dissent seeking hike; Warsh rejects forward guidance
summary: The FOMC kept its benchmark rate at 3.75%-4% on October 28. Chair Kevin Warsh said the Fed does not favor forward guidance and plans fewer press conferences from 2027. Governors Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented, both seeking a 25bp hike. Markets are pricing a December rate hike.
why: 美联储10月按兵不动符合市场预期，但两票鹰派反对（Cook+Hammack）及12月加息预期上升，将抬高短端利率预期，对科技股估值和sell put隐含波动率均有潜在上行压力。

title: Alphabet Q3 search revenue misses estimates; free cash flow turns negative; stock falls 10%+ after hours
summary: Alphabet Q3 2026 revenue was $127.6B (+25% YoY), but Google Search revenue of $63.35B missed the $64.85B consensus. Free cash flow was negative $9.07B vs. $2.70B expected, dragged by elevated capex and an $8.7B equity-security loss. EPS also missed. The stock fell more than 10% in after-hours trading.
why: 谷歌搜索收入承压叠加资本开支激增导致自由现金流首度转负，引发市场对AI投资回报的担忧；盘后跌逾10%对科技板块整体情绪形成拖累，GOOGL相关仓位的隐含波动率将大幅上升。

title: SK hynix Q3 2026: first quarter above 100T KRW; ~80% operating margin; HBM4 enters mass production
summary: SK hynix Q3 2026 revenue surpassed 100T KRW for the first time in company history, with operating profit at approximately 80% operating margin, exceeding analyst estimates. The board approved a 14T KRW Q3 dividend and a 20T KRW share buyback. HBM4 entered full-scale mass production in Q3 and is expected to surpass HBM3E in Q4.
why: SK海力士HBM4量产超预期，AI基础设施需求仍极度旺盛，对NVDA/MU/7709.HK等整体AI芯片链构成正向催化；创纪录利润率确认先进内存供需关系依然极度紧绷。

title: 泡泡玛特Q3营收按年暴跌45%-50% Labubu热度消退 海外市场美洲降幅最大
summary: 泡泡玛特(9992.HK)公布未经审计三季度业绩，营收按年下跌45%-50%，境外市场（尤其美洲地区）跌幅最大，境内跌幅相对较小。股价在公告后最多下跌6%至约18个月低位123.8港元。
why: Labubu热度退潮导致季度营收骤跌逾四成，超出市场最悲观预期；对9992.HK的sell put策略而言波动率飙升、下行风险真实存在，需立即评估行权价位是否已脱离安全区。

title: Meituan raises ~$1 billion in second dim sum bond; 5-year at 2.90%, 10-year at 3.60%
summary: Meituan (3690.HK) mandated seven banks for a dual-tranche offshore yuan (dim sum) bond sale. Guidance set at 2.90% for 5-year and 3.60% for 10-year notes on October 26. Proceeds earmarked for refinancing offshore debt and general corporate purposes. This is Meituan's second dim sum bond deal following its 2025 debut.
why: 延续报道：债券于10月26日定价，结算尚未完成（T+5），发行影响持续至本周。美团以低利率完成第二只点心债，对Keeta海外扩张资金保障积极；Bloomberg为硬墙信源且未能提供cross_ref，标verified:false。
